title: The key in the door
notes: Storyboard and plan agree on the words. The plan's slum street (New Town ≈01:30) is dropped: the line is about building, so it opens on the plan becoming houses.

'Councils commissioned homes' is New Town's blueprint turning into a green estate as houses and terraces pop up on the plots; 'Builders built them' is Pop Goes the Weasel's bricklayers on a scaffold (live action, B/W, 1948); 'Families moved in' is New Town's removal van and a chair walking up the path.
MOW stills are 800 px Commons copies of IWM web derivatives: INSET, never pushed. They carry a visible 'IWM' watermark bottom right.
No credit string is recorded in footage.md for the MOW stills (Crown copyright expired, via Commons); owed for the end credits.
The patriotism line (P6.16) lands on MOW-T51849 'Designs for the People's House': a finished living room, fireplace, armchairs. INSET+HOLD, the line lands on stillness.
